formulas.ascii: T = gain * sum over levels k of w_k * (G_(k-1) - G_k); G_-1 = elevation, G_k = Gaussian blur of the elevation with sigma_k = baseSigma * 2^k (separable cascade, edge pixels replicated, nodata by normalized convolution), w_k = 2^(-k * detail); output in metres times gain, NaN at an invalid centre
